metadata.title: New type of bubbling solutions to a critical fractional Schrödinger equation with double potentials
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the following critical fractional Schrödinger equation: \begin{equation} (-\Delta)^s u+V(|y'|,y'')u=K(|y'|,y'')u^{\frac{n+2s}{n-2s}},\quad u>0,\quad y =(y',y'') \in \mathbb{R}^3\times\mathbb{R}^{n-3}, \qquad(0.1)\end{equation} where $n\geq 3$, $s\in(0,1)$, $V(|y'|,y'')$ and $K(|y'|,y'')$ are two bounded nonnegative potential functions. Under the conditions that $K(r,y'')$ has a stable critical point $(r_0,y_0'')$ with $r_0>0$, $K(r_0,y_0'')>0$ and $V(r_0,y_0'')>0$, we prove that equation (0.1) has a new type of infinitely many solutions that concentrate at points lying on the top and the bottom of a cylinder. In particular, the bubble solutions can concentrate at a pair of symmetric points with respect to the origin. Our proofs make use of a modified finite-dimensional reduction method and local Pohozaev identities.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 分数阶临界方程的双层多泡
analysis.workSummary: 定理1.1及1.2对满足(1.5)的n≥4及分数阶s，在R³×Rⁿ⁻³的径向双势临界方程中，为每个充分大的k构造上下各k个气泡的正解。V、K有界非负，V在中心附近为C²、K为C³，且r₀>0、K与V在中心取正值、∇K的局部度非零。
techniques: 截断的标准分数阶泡及上下各k个中心
加权最大范数的线性理论和不动点
局部 Pohozaev 恒等式与稳定临界点的度
analysis.breakthrough: 定理1.1中高度参数趋于1，上下两组气泡分别向两极集中，y₀″=0时极限点对关于原点对称。定理1.2的高度参数趋于a∈[0,1)，可对应两条分离的纬圈或同趋赤道。两者气泡尺度λ按不同的k幂律增长。
analysis.limitations: PDF v1第4页(1.5)的n≥6分支印为(3n−3+√(n²−2n+9))/8<s<1，左端大于1，按印式这一分支为空。n=4、5仍有单列的非空s区间。摘要开头n≥3、0<s<1描述的是方程背景，实际存在性定理附带(1.5)和K1–K3。未独立验证加权估计与约化的全部步骤。

analysis.priorityReason: 分数阶临界问题的多峰构造可供比较局部恒等式与气泡相互作用。
